title: Chapter 2 — Night Shift
description: One full night at Sugar Palace, from the first Star lager to the last taxi, and the house rules that decide what kind of house it is.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Six p.m. The generator coughs awake. Kokoro hangs the sign: SUGAR PALACE: COLD DRINKS, HOT PEPPER SOUP, NO FIGHTING. Somebody has added in marker: "NO CREDIT".

beats.speaker: kemi
beats.text: Mama, before the customers come. The new girls are asking what the rules are. The real ones, not the sign.

beats.speaker: kemi
beats.text: Every house on South Street has rules. Yours have never been written down.

options.text: Write them on the wall: no girl under eighteen, no man who hits, no girl who doesn't want to, and Mama decides who leaves.
"The rules are me. If you have a problem, come to me."

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Nine p.m. Full house. A wedding party that has escaped its own wedding. Three Shell engineers on their last night of leave. A man in a choir robe who asks for "the quiet table".

good.toast: The wedding party buys a round for the whole bar, twice. The groom cries. The bride pays.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Midnight. A boy at the gate. School shoes under his trousers. Sixteen, maybe, holding ₦5,000 like a ticket to adulthood. He asks for "the new girl. The one who smiles."

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: The ₦5,000 is shaking in his hand.

options.text: Take his money, buy him a Fanta, put him in a taxi home and tell his mother's street name to the driver.
"Not tonight. Come back when your voice has broken." Turn him away.
"Money is money." Let him in to the bar to drink.

beats.speaker: kemi
beats.text: (pointing at the wall) Rule one, Mama. You wrote it yourself, four hours ago.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Four a.m. The last taxi. You count the drawer while Blessing stacks chairs and sings Asa songs badly. Kokoro is asleep across the gate like a bolt.

beats.speaker: player
beats.text: This is the house. This is what it pays for: Ivie's school, the girls' rent, Kokoro's chair, Chief Dapo's mortgage.

beats.title: Night Shift
beats.summary: One night, start to finish. Whatever rules you wrote, the girls read them on your face before they read them on the wall.
